svg.title: LTC3621 fixed 3.3 V regulator with a pushbutton and GPIO hold diode
svg.desc: Two panels connected by named RUN, BAT+ and GND nets. Power-stage pins use the MS8E package numbering. MODE/SYNC is connected to INTVCC for Burst Mode. A normally open button and resistor divider start RUN; a BAS116 diode holds RUN from a 3.3 V GPIO. STM32N6 sequencing and USB source control are not implemented in this diagram.
svg.text: 8–13.2 V input | Fixed 3.3 V output | 250 mA illustrative load | Common ground
N6 already controls internal-SMPS shutdown and PWR_ON. External AUX switching/discharge is not shown.
Main supplies must remain valid until every AUX rail is below 0.6 V; qualify the external delay or hold-up.
Direct GPIO HOLD is only the latch core. A dedicated sequencer IC is optional; USB source control is still required.
RUN must not exceed VIN in any supply state. Take over HOLD before the start button is released.
L/C values are starting values; qualify exact MPNs, derating, startup, load response and current capability.
Electrical connection diagram, not a package view. Filled dots join branches; matching RUN, BAT+ and GND labels join nets.
